name: Grove Titan
primary:
A giant grove titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either throws seed pods that burst within 2 blocks: damage 2.5 ❤ earth, roots for 3 s;
or slams the ground with both fists, which grows grass and flowers, heals you and your summons within 7 blocks by 2 ❤ with regeneration; foes within 5 blocks take 2 ❤ earth and are rooted for 4 s.
self_description:
On you:
• Heal 4 ❤
• Regeneration II, 10 s
